mcpTools.name: knowledge_approve_merge_request
mcpTools.description: Approve an open merge request as the connected user. Counts toward the MR_REQUIRED_APPROVALS merge gate unless that user also authored it (self-approvals never count). Only approve when the user asks you to.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_close_merge_request
mcpTools.description: Close an open merge request without merging (reopenable via the REST API).

mcpTools.name: knowledge_comment_merge_request
mcpTools.description: Comment on an open merge request: replies into the given thread, or starts a new (unanchored) discussion thread when threadId is omitted.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_compare_revisions
mcpTools.description: GitLab-style comparison of two revisions: "direct" (diff from..to) or "merge-base" (diff from...to against the nearest common ancestor).

mcpTools.name: knowledge_create_branch
mcpTools.description: Create a branch on a document, from a given revision or the default-branch head.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_create_document
mcpTools.description: Create a new page from markdown in a project, optionally nested under another page. It is indexed in the background (poll knowledge_get_document for status "indexed"). To change an existing page, branch and open a merge request instead. To start from a template (an ADR, RFC, runbook…), pass templateRef and the placeholder values knowledge_get_template lists — with no content the server fills the template in; with content, yours wins and the template is recorded as where the page came from.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_create_merge_request
mcpTools.description: Open a GitLab-style merge request between two branches of a document. Target defaults to the default branch.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_create_revision
mcpTools.description: Create a new markdown revision on a branch (immutable; parented on the branch head), upload the content and finalize it for indexing. Pass baseRevisionId for optimistic concurrency: the call is rejected if the branch head has moved past it. Content without a frontmatter block keeps the branch head's frontmatter (tags, relations); include a block to replace it.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_export
mcpTools.description: Export a page, a page and its subpages, or a whole project as a file a person can download (docs/features/45): zip (markdown sources with frontmatter, attachments and manifest.json), html (an offline site, zipped) or pdf (only where the deployment has Gotenberg). Give documentId, or projectId for a whole project. Runs in the background: returns the export id — poll knowledge_get_export for the download URL.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_feedback
mcpTools.description: Rate an answer you built from knowledge_search: up or down, with a reason on down. Quote the search's traceId so a re-vote updates the same row. Votes and reasons are what turns a bad answer into documentation work; nothing else changes.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_find_relations
mcpTools.description: Neighborhood of an entity: documents referencing it (with relation type, fact class, confidence) and entities within N hops.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_flag_document
mcpTools.description: Set a page's declared verification state (docs/features/39): "requested" asks its owner to check it (any member), "outdated" declares it wrong (editor) and ranks it last in search until a person verifies or clears it. Give a note saying why. Verifying is a person's act and has no tool. For a problem with evidence that should be checked and fixed, prefer knowledge_report_issue.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_get_connector_run
mcpTools.description: One sync run: status, current stage, and how many pages were created, updated, skipped, failed or left as conflicts. Warnings list what a run could not carry.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_get_document
mcpTools.description: Get a document, its head (or a given) revision and indexed chunk summaries.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_get_document_content
mcpTools.description: The full markdown (and parsed frontmatter) of a document at its default-branch head or a given revision. Read this before writing a revision: a revision replaces the whole page. `markdown` is the body without its frontmatter block; posting it back as-is keeps the frontmatter.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_get_export
mcpTools.description: One export: its status (queued | running | completed | failed | expired), page count and size, and — once completed — a download URL valid for a few minutes. Only the person who asked for it, or an admin, sees it.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_get_historical_context
mcpTools.description: What the knowledge base stated about an entity at a given revision (plan.md §11 historical queries): the fact snapshot at that point in the revision DAG, plus the entity\u2019s current neighborhood for contrast.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_get_merge_request
mcpTools.description: Get one merge request (heads, merge base, approvals, reviewers, draft flag). Set includeDiff for the merge-base text+structural diff, semantic for the graph-projection diff too.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_get_page_access
mcpTools.description: The restrictions on a page as they apply to you: whether it is restricted itself, the restricted pages and project above it, and your effective level (view | edit | manage). Grants are listed only when you may manage the page. Use it when a write is refused, or before telling someone a page is visible to a team.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_get_template
mcpTools.description: One template: its markdown source, category, default tags and relations, and the placeholders (name, kind, required) to pass as values to knowledge_create_document.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_get_workflow_run
mcpTools.description: A workflow run with its frozen step graph and its node tree — every intermediate result, including drafts still awaiting review.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_get_workspace_graph
mcpTools.description: The whole workspace (or one project) as a single relation graph: every document as a node, every entity it references, and the typed edges between them with provenance. Use this for an overview of how a knowledge base hangs together — or to find orphan pages, which appear with degree 0. For one page's neighbourhood use knowledge_find_relations instead.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_impact_analysis
mcpTools.description: Transitive impact of changing an entity: dependents (what breaks) or dependencies (what it relies on), with document evidence paths.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_ingest
mcpTools.description: Force reindex of a document\u2019s branch-head revisions (or every branch head in the workspace).

mcpTools.name: knowledge_list_agent_learnings
mcpTools.description: Corrections this team taught its agents ("learnings"), newest first. Active ones are approved by an admin and are what the platform's own agents are told — follow them when you do the same kind of work. Pass agentKey for one agent's list (it includes learnings for every agent).

mcpTools.name: knowledge_list_agents
mcpTools.description: s AI calls (feature 20): which agents exist, what each is for, " + +

mcpTools.name: knowledge_list_connectors
mcpTools.description: List the external systems this workspace syncs with (Confluence, Jira, Notion, markdown/git). Each entry says which direction it moves content, how many pages it has claimed, and how its last sync went.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_list_documents
mcpTools.description: The page tree of a workspace, optionally one project: titles, ids, categories, nesting and each page's verification state. Archived pages are absent unless includeArchived is true. Use it to browse; use knowledge_search to find.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_list_merge_requests
mcpTools.description: List merge requests across a workspace, filterable by document, status, author, or assigned reviewer. Cursor-paginated; mergeBaseRevisionId is null in list rows (fetch one MR for it).

mcpTools.name: knowledge_list_projects
mcpTools.description: List the projects in a workspace. Workspace > Project > Document — every document belongs to exactly one project.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_list_revisions
mcpTools.description: List the immutable revision DAG of a document (parent ids, branch, status).

mcpTools.name: knowledge_list_templates
mcpTools.description: List the page templates offered in a workspace (built-ins such as builtin:adr, builtin:runbook, builtin:postmortem, plus the workspace's own). Pass projectId to include that project's templates.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_list_work_items
mcpTools.description: Issues and pull requests on a connected repository, with the page each one is attached to. Use it to find out what work is open against something before writing about it. A "merged" pull request finished; a "closed" one was abandoned.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_list_workflows
mcpTools.description: List workflow definitions in a workspace: configurable step chains (entity → use-cases → API endpoints + pages) that can be run against a page.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_merge_revision
mcpTools.description: Merge an open merge request ("merge-commit" creates a two-parent DAG node, "squash" a single-parent one). Fails with a comparison link when the target branch diverged — rebase the source branch first. Gated: draft MRs and MRs below MR_REQUIRED_APPROVALS non-author approvals are rejected with 409 details.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_propose_agent_learning
mcpTools.description: Propose a learning: a correction for one agent (or every agent), in plain words. It is stored as proposed and reaches no prompt until a workspace admin approves it in the app.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_query_graph
mcpTools.description: TRUSTED-OPERATOR ONLY (plan.md §9): read-only SQL over the graph store. Single SELECT statement, row-limited, workspace predicate enforced server-side; every call is written to the audit log.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_repo_wiki
mcpTools.description: s repo wiki: its sections and the page each one is, which are stale or waiting in a merge request, and how the repository

mcpTools.name: knowledge_report_issue
mcpTools.description: Report that a page is wrong, out of date, missing something, or a duplicate. Quote the passage and say where the correct information is. The report is checked by the sentinel and may become a merge request for a person to review; a second report of the same page and kind folds into the open one. Returns the issue, its status (open | checking | proposed) and whether it was deduplicated.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_request_access
mcpTools.description: Ask for view or edit access to a page you were refused. Its managers and the workspace admins are notified, and you are told when they decide. Only when a person asked for it: the request is sent in their name. Refused with 409 when you already have that level or already asked.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_search
mcpTools.description: Semantic search over the knowledge base. Every result carries document/revision/chunk citations plus provenance: revisionNumber, changedAt (freshness), authorName, verification / trust.status (verified | expired | edited | requested | outdated | flagged | unverified), trust.inactive, trust.ownerId and factClass. Ranking already favours verified pages and demotes outdated ones; still say when a page you relied on is outdated, expired or edited since verification. Archived pages are absent unless includeArchived is true. The response traceId identifies this search.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_share_page
mcpTools.description: Create a public, read-only link to a page (docs/features/43) that anyone with the URL can open without signing in — only when a person asked for one. includeSubtree also shares every page under it. Without expiresInDays the link never expires, which most workspaces only allow with a password. Fails with 403 when the workspace has sharing switched off. Returns the URL; revoke it from the page's Share menu.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_start_workflow
mcpTools.description: Start a workflow run against a source page. Returns immediately — the run executes in the background and parks at its first review gate. 409 when a run of the same workflow is already in flight for that page.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_sync_connector
mcpTools.description: Start a sync run for one connector and return the run to poll with knowledge_get_connector_run. Pulling is idempotent: unchanged items are skipped, and an item changed on both sides opens a merge request rather than overwriting anything.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_trace_relation
mcpTools.description: Shortest relation path between two entities, alternating entity/document steps with edge types.

mcpTools.name: knowledge_whoami
mcpTools.description: Start here. Who this connection acts as, what its API key is limited to, and every workspace it can reach with your role in it and its projects (ids included). Every other tool takes one of these workspaceIds.
